content:
Here’s a clearer, more concise version:

The RH archiving change (story 2323911) is causing active trades that aren’t archived in CMRS to be reported to TRAX as REPL instead of NEWM. This affects the #13 fix: the new ESP extract sends replay messages for rebooked trades (updated with original Position Trader via OMS linkages). Because these messages are flagged with <SST_REPLAY> = ‘Y’, RH submits them to TRAX as REPL. TRAX will reject them since these trades were never reported previously. In short, the #13 replayed trade messages will be rejected like other BAU replays, rendering the #13 changes from ESP and RH ineffective.
